planets.name: K2-32 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-32 with a 31.7-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-32 d was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around K2-32. Its orbit and size follow Lillo-Box et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
